svg.text: Sweep: chain of two, run length 50 to 5000 — counts-short
relative error |found − true| / |true| (log scale) against run length of the short variant (steps; the long variant is twice as long)
dashed: the Cramér–Rao bound (1 SE); dotted: the scorer's tolerance; filled dot: pass, open: not a pass; top edge: part not found
